traits.inflorescence.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Capsicum (genus account), p. 658 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): flowers solitary, sometimes 2 or 3 together; Flora of British India (p. 238): pedicels from the leaf axils, single or 2-3.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Capsicum (genus account), p. 658 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla rotate, usually 5-lobed.

traits.fruit_type.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Capsicum (genus account), p. 658 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a juiceless berry, many-seeded.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Capsicum (genus account), p. 658 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves ovate or nearly elliptical, entire, acuminate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Capsicum (genus account), p. 658 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves entire; Flora of British India: entire or repand.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Capsicum (genus account), p. 658 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves acuminate.
